author: PackRat 🐀
name: Helldivers 2 Galactic War
description: A live Galactic War command panel for XENEON Edge using community Helldivers 2 data. Track the Major Order, priority campaign fronts, deployed players, derived front progress, active defenses, and planet details across layouts tuned for every XENEON slot. Touch the Major Order for objective detail and tap any campaign card for a focused planet view. Uses factual text names and data only, with no game art, logos, or faction insignia.
